items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: And we were saved by Henry "Shorty" Matthews, the comedian, who had had a little experience playing drums. All we wanted really was someone that was able to keep time on the drums and we were still in business.

ctx.x: Herbie was placed in the best army hospital where we visited him a few times before he was sent home. He had the best of medical care possible and was told that the arm could be saved and he would be able to play again.

We began to wonder if we would be sent back to the States before our time of six months had terminated. We were supposed to go to Japan after our tour of the Philippines and I really didn't want to miss out on that. And we were saved by Henry "Shorty" Matthews, the comedian, who had had a little experience playing drums. All we wanted really was someone that was able to keep time on the drums and we were still in business.
